newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Cookson warns on sterling strength.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Cookson warns on sterling strength.

text.p: British electronic, ceramic and plastic industrial materials company Cookson Group Plc said on Thursday that between five and 10 million stg could be cut from earnings this year if the pound remained at current levels.

"Sterling strength is not too big a problem but it could have an effect of five to 10 million this year if sterling stays as strong as it is. It's not the end of the world because most of our businesses manufacture and sell the product in the local currency,' chief executive Richard Oster said in a telephone interview.
